evidence.decision: Distinguishes a flat mutually exclusive value from commands/multiselect/submenus and defines displayed default, committed state and Custom cancellation.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a label/options/default/commit artifact with explicit persistence and preview semantics.
evidence.transformation: Mixed Options/Portrait/Landscape/Print becomes an Orientation pop-up reflecting stored selection and a separate direct Print command.
evidence.verification: Checks repeated/default/external changes, Custom cancellation and long labels; fails stale displayed values and commands disguised as choices.
evidence.applicability: Scopes compact iPad modal substitution and TV/Watch absence; does not assert automatic persistence or native keyboard behavior.
evidence.handoffs: Hands command lists to Pull-down buttons, alternate choice surfaces to Pickers and organization to Menus.
evidence.distinctiveness: Single stored value, hidden option purpose and cancellation-before-commit make this a real selection procedure.
